clue.text: Cut a little corn, storing it in outbuilding

indicators.note: the outbuilding keeps the bit of corn stored inside its letters

parts.note: a shed is a small outbuilding
an ear is a single small head of corn

explanation.surface: Someone trims a small amount of grain and keeps it in the garden shed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cut' could be an instruction, but it is the definition, a past tense meaning clipped.
explanation.definitionFit: Sheared is a past tense of shear, to clip or trim, so it is a synonym of cut.

clue.text: Ride accepted by shy boy

indicators.note: taken in by, so the ride goes inside the word for shy

parts.note: to shy is to throw, as is to sling
a trip is a journey or ride

explanation.surface: A bashful boy agrees to go for a ride.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shy' reads as bashful but is the verb meaning throw, as at a coconut shy.
explanation.definitionFit: A stripling is a youth, a lad not yet fully grown.

clue.text: Provoked as former partner gets summoned to court

parts.note: an ex is a former spouse or partner
to be cited is to be summoned to appear in court

explanation.surface: Someone is aggravated because their ex has been called to court.
explanation.definitionFit: Excited can mean stirred up or roused, so it is a synonym of provoked.

clue.text: Apologetic agent -tenant needs time to move

parts.note: a rep, short for representative, is an agent

indicators.note: the letter for time has to shift to a new position within the word tenant

explanation.surface: An estate agent tells a tenant that it is time to move out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to move' shifts the first T of TENANT two places on, making ENTANT.
explanation.definitionFit: Repentant means feeling regret for wrongdoing, so sorry and apologetic.

clue.text: Diver originally an expert swimmer

indicators.note: originally points to the start, so only the first letter of diver is used

parts.note: an ace is an expert

explanation.surface: A diver who began as a top-class swimmer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'swimmer' is the definition, for a fish, not the diver.
explanation.definitionFit: The dace is a small freshwater fish, so a swimmer.

clue.text: Again take in to study at American college

parts.note: to read a subject is to study it, especially at university
MIT is the Massachusetts Institute of Technology

explanation.surface: Someone is accepted back to study at a college in the United States.
explanation.definitionFit: To readmit is to allow back in, i.e. to accept once more.

clue.text: They lay off risks and check on horse certain to run second

parts.note: a rein checks or restrains a horse
sure means certain
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: Bookmakers hedge their bets after checking whether a horse is sure to come second.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lay off' is the betting term for passing risk to another party, which is what reinsurers do with insurance risks.
explanation.definitionFit: Reinsurers take on part of an insurer's liabilities, letting it pass on its exposure.

clue.text: Girl giving a sign for something to be removed

parts.words: sign for something to be removed
parts.note: dele is the proofreader's mark meaning delete

explanation.surface: A young woman signals that something must be taken away.
explanation.walkthrough: DELE, Latin for 'delete', is a proofreading mark.
explanation.definitionFit: Adele is a girl's name.

clue.text: Uneasy feeling as article is accepted by Tom

indicators.note: taken in by, so the article and is go inside the tom word

parts.note: a tom is a male cat, so tom means male
a is the indefinite article
taken as written

explanation.surface: A tom is given something and feels ill at ease about it.
explanation.walkthrough: A tom is a male cat, so 'Tom' stands for the general word for a male.
explanation.definitionFit: Malaise is a vague sense of discomfort or unease.

clue.text: Covered in sticky stuff-don't step on it!

definitions.meaning: step on it means hurry, so the opposite is to linger or delay

explanation.surface: A warning about freshly laid sticky material on the path.
explanation.walkthrough: The first sense rhymes with 'starry', the second with 'marry'.
explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective it means coated with tar; as a verb it means to linger.

clue.text: About to 'be recruited into theatre company for short rehearsal

indicators.note: being recruited into a company means joining its ranks, so these letters go inside

parts.note: rep is short for a repertory theatre company
ca is the abbreviation of circa, Latin for about

explanation.surface: Someone is about to join a theatre troupe in time for a brief run-through.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rehearsal' here is a going-over or retelling, not a stage practice; the theatre surface pushes the wrong sense.
explanation.definitionFit: A recap is a brief summary, and rehearsal can mean a recounting of points, so a short one fits.

clue.text: Cheat, using English in translation of Schiller

indicators.note: the English letter sits inside the rearranged name
translating the name is taken as turning its letters into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A con artist passes off an English version of the German poet Schiller.
explanation.walkthrough: 'translation of' rearranges SCHILLER, and 'in' puts E among those letters to give CHIS-E-LLER.
explanation.definitionFit: A chiseller is a swindler, someone who cheats people out of money.

clue.text: Powerful drug gets clear backing for internal use

indicators.note: used internally means put inside, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: pot is slang for cannabis

indicators.note: backing means going in reverse, so the word for clear is read backwards

parts.note: to net is to clear as profit

explanation.surface: A strong medicine comes with clear support for being taken internally.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' gives the reversed clear word, and 'for internal use' puts it inside the drug word.
explanation.definitionFit: Potent is a direct synonym of powerful, of drugs or arguments alike.

clue.text: It preys with a terrible sharpness

indicators.note: something terrible is in a dreadful state, so these letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A predator hunts with dreadful keenness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'terrible' rearranges IT, PREYS and A into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Asperity is harshness or severity of tone, a sharpness of manner.

clue.text: Traders vie frantically for person who can increase their sales

definitions.text: person who can increase their sales

indicators.note: acting frantically means wildly and in disorder, so these letters are shuffled

explanation.surface: Merchants compete desperately for someone who will boost their business.
explanation.walkthrough: 'frantically' rearranges TRADERS and VIE.
explanation.definitionFit: An advertiser promotes goods publicly, which is meant to boost trade.

clue.text: Having gained seat, departs with first-class return for the country

parts.note: a candidate who has gained a seat is in, elected
d is the abbreviation for departs in timetables

indicators.note: a return comes back the way it went, so the letters for first-class run backwards

parts.note: A1 means first-class, written here as AI

explanation.surface: A politician, newly elected, leaves with a first-class return ticket to their homeland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'return' turns AI (A1, first-class) into IA. A seated MP is 'in'.
explanation.definitionFit: India is a country in South Asia.

clue.text: Very inexpensive hat priced in error

indicators.note: a mistake scrambles the order, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A hat has been given a price that is far too low by mistake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in error' rearranges HAT and PRICED.
explanation.definitionFit: Dirt cheap is an idiom for costing almost nothing.

clue.text: Arrived with gunners and soldiers — they're prepared to shoot

parts.note: came means arrived
RA is the Royal Artillery, the gunners
men is a common word for soldiers, the ranks

explanation.surface: Artillery and infantry have turned up, ready to open fire.
explanation.walkthrough: The military surface makes 'shoot' mean fire, but it means film.
explanation.definitionFit: Camera operators shoot film, so they are ready to shoot in the filming sense.

clue.text: A little money transmitted for deposit in bank without delay

parts.note: p, a penny, is a small amount of money

indicators.note: deposited inside, so the transmitted word goes within the bank word

parts.note: to bank on is to rely on
sent means transmitted

explanation.surface: A small sum is wired to be paid into a bank immediately.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bank' looks like the financial institution but is the verb, as in 'bank on'.
explanation.definitionFit: Presently can mean at once or immediately, an older sense still used.

clue.text: Large stand needed for group of stars

parts.note: great means large
to bear is to stand or tolerate

explanation.surface: A big grandstand is required for a gathering of celebrities.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stand' looks like a noun but is the verb, to put up with.
explanation.definitionFit: The Great Bear, Ursa Major, is a constellation, a named cluster of stars.

clue.text: One can hear within this the result of being talked about?

definitions.meaning: the range within which a sound can be heard

definitions.text: the result of being talked about?
definitions.meaning: folklore says your ears burn, growing hot, when others are talking about you

explanation.surface: A riddle about what happens when people gossip about you within your hearing.
explanation.walkthrough: The second sense splits the answer as EARS HOT, from the saying that your ears burn when someone discusses you.
explanation.definitionFit: Earshot is the distance within which a voice can be heard.

clue.text: Old man' hiding in tree goes back to another one

indicators.note: going back means reading in reverse, so the whole assembled tree word runs backwards
the old man is concealed inside the tree's letters

parts.note: an elm is a tree
pa is a familiar word for father, an old man

explanation.surface: An elderly man hides in a tree and then retreats to a different one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'goes back' reverses the whole tree-with-father result, ELPAM; 'another one' points to a tree other than the one just mentioned.
explanation.definitionFit: A maple is a tree, so it is another one besides the elm.

clue.text: Experts introducing girl to special craft

indicators.note: introducing one word to another puts it inside, so the girl goes into the boat word

parts.note: a punt is a flat-bottomed boat, a craft
Di is a short girl's name

explanation.surface: Specialists bring a young woman into a particular trade.
explanation.walkthrough: 'craft' suggests a skill but is a boat, the flat-bottomed kind poled along English rivers.
explanation.definitionFit: Pundits are authorities who give expert opinion.

clue.text: One depends on host to arrange parties around area

indicators.note: the rearranged letters wrap around the abbreviation for area
to arrange is to put in a new order, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone relies on the host to organise parties all over the district.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arrange' rearranges PARTIES, and 'around' puts those letters round A.
explanation.definitionFit: A parasite is an organism living off another, its host, on which it depends.

clue.text: Fish unlikely to be this long!

definitions.text: Fish unlikely to be this long!

parts.words: Fish unlikely to be this long!
parts.note: the answer names a freshwater fish and also an old unit of length of five and a half yards, far longer than any such fish

explanation.surface: An angler's tall tale about the size of a catch.
explanation.walkthrough: The unit of length is also called a rod or pole, equal to 5.5 yards.
explanation.definitionFit: It is both a common freshwater fish and an old measure of length.

clue.text: Keen character on the staff

definitions.meaning: keen means acute or with a fine edge
a musical symbol written on the stave raising a note by a semitone

explanation.surface: An eager member of the office team.
explanation.walkthrough: 'staff' is the musical stave, not employees.
explanation.definitionFit: A keen edge cuts well, and in music the symbol raising a note shares the name.

clue.text: Enclosure constructed in iron to mark the border

indicators.note: built within, so the enclosure goes inside the symbol for iron

parts.note: Fe is the chemical symbol for iron
a ring is an enclosed area, as for boxing or a circus

explanation.surface: A pen made of iron is built to show where the boundary lies.
explanation.walkthrough: 'constructed in' puts RING inside FE. 'iron' looks like the building material but is the chemical symbol.
explanation.definitionFit: To fringe something is to edge it, forming its border.

clue.text: Vehicle originally second came first

indicators.note: originally points to the start, so only the first letter of second is used

parts.note: led means came first, was in front

explanation.surface: A racing car first ran second and then won.
explanation.walkthrough: 'originally' takes S from 'second'.
explanation.definitionFit: A sled is a sledge, a vehicle on runners for snow.

clue.text: Trial run with judges in actual case

indicators.note: the judging word goes inside the word for actual, which acts as its case

parts.note: real means actual
a judge hears a case in court

explanation.surface: A trial run takes place with judges hearing a real court case.
explanation.walkthrough: 'case' tells us the actual word is the container. The legal surface hides that 'judges' is a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: A rehearsal is a practice performance, a trial run before the real thing.

clue.text: Damp fog with nothing discernible in it

indicators.note: able to be seen inside it, so the nothing letter sits within the fog word

parts.note: mist is a thin fog
O, the shape of zero, means nothing

explanation.surface: A damp fog so thick that nothing can be seen through it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'discernible in it' puts O inside MIST.
explanation.definitionFit: Moist means slightly wet, so it is a synonym of damp.

clue.text: Rash person nominally associated with London club

definitions.meaning: a hothead, someone impetuous, after Shakespeare's headstrong Harry Percy
Tottenham ... is a London football club, so the word is part of its name

explanation.surface: A reckless individual has a tenuous connection to a gentlemen's club in London.
explanation.walkthrough: Tottenham Hotspur, 'Spurs', is a London football club; 'club' suggests a gentlemen's club.
explanation.definitionFit: Shakespeare's Harry Percy was nicknamed for his impetuosity, so the name became a byword for a hothead.

clue.text: Extremely dirty and unpleasant lot of rulers

indicators.note: the extremes of a word are its first and last letters

parts.note: nasty means unpleasant

explanation.surface: A family of monarchs that was utterly filthy and disagreeable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Extremely' takes the first and last letters of DIRTY, D and Y.
explanation.definitionFit: A dynasty is a succession of rulers from the same family.
